## Issues filed by this close-out — two

- **#9487** — every 401 answers `{"error":"UNAUTHENTICATED","message":…}` with **no `code` key**, while the other six error families answer `{error, code}`; a client keying on `body.code` reads `undefined` for every auth failure, and it already cost #9333 two clauses.
- **#9488** — `GET /api/v1/meta/<unknown-type>` answers `200 {"items":[]}`, indistinguishable from a real-but-empty type, while the write door for the same name refuses precisely (#8421 fixed only the write side).

Both were designated for extraction by the Tier-2A reviewer of record ("worth their own cards rather than burial in a run record") and were the only defect findings in the wave with no card. Both dup-checked by keyword and error string, both carry a `QA-source:` line, both filed with `bug` only — **no `pm:*` label, no assignee, no priority** — so they enter normal triage first-touch. Everything else the records name was already carded: **#9454**, **#9468** and **#9469** had already been extracted from Tier-2B/2C at review time, so the dup rule applied and nothing was re-filed.

## Residuals — for your decision, not done here

1. **Three records still carry work labels the wave's own rule forbids**: #9334 has `bug` + `regression`, #9351 has `bug` (its 2026-08-17 extraction comment says the label moved to #9362, but the removal never happened), and ten of the fourteen carry `tracking`. I made **no label writes** — none was in this card's mandate, and all fourteen are now closed so no sweep can pick them up. Cheap to fix if you want the record clean.
2. **The checklist-accuracy corrections are not merely parked** — they have a card, **#9386**, whose PR #9427 (RUNNER environment facts) is merged and whose PR #9475 (the 32 item corrections, including the `no-active-org-session-semantics` `blocked` marker and the `first-run-loop` un-blocking) is still **open**. My close-out comments call this "the ledger-edit PR"; #9386 / #9475 is its name.
3. **#9417's four fixture/environment findings designated for the fixture card #9308** (absent `plugin-reports`, three inert sharing rules, `showcase_declarative_connector_ping` on a non-3000 boot, the missing credentialed personas) were **not** posted to #9308 — outside this card's scope. They stay readable on the records and parked on #9296.
4. **#9298** (R0) is still open and is not a `qa-run` record, so it was out of scope here.

Nothing was left unclassified: every FAIL in the four completed runs had sufficient evidence on its own record to classify.
